lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਪੀਓ ਰੇ ਦਗਰਾ ॥੩॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: raam rasaain peeo re dagaraa ||3||4||
lines.translation: Drink in the sublime elixir of the Lord, O deceitful one. ||3||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿ ਚੀਨੑਸੀ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਨ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham j cheenhsee aasaa te na bhaavasee ||
lines.translation: One who recognizes the Supreme Lord God, dislikes other desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾ ਭਗਤਹ ਚੇਤੀਅਲੇ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਸੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raamaa bhagatah cheteeale achi(n)t man raakhasee ||1||
lines.translation: He focuses his consciousness on the Lord's devotional worship, and keeps his mind free of anxiety. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਤਰਹਿਗਾ ਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੋ ਬਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaise man tarahigaa re sa(n)saar saagar bikhai ko banaa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, how will you cross over the world-ocean, if you are filled with the water of corruption?

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭੂਲਾ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothee maaiaa dekh kai bhoolaa re manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the falseness of Maya, you have gone astray, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੀਪੇ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੈਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਭੈਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chheepe ke ghar janam dailaa gur upades bhailaa ||
lines.translation: You have given me birth in the house of a calico-printer, but I have found the Teachings of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੁਲਾ ॥੨॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tah kai parasaad naamaa har bhetulaa ||2||5||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Saint, Naam Dayv has met the Lord. ||2||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa baanee sree ravidaas jeeu kee ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, The Word Of The Reverend Ravi Daas Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮੀਨ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਪਤੰਗ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਏਕ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: mrig meen bhri(n)g pata(n)g ku(n)char ek dokh binaas ||
lines.translation: The deer, the fish, the bumble bee, the moth and the elephant are destroyed, each for a single defect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch dokh asaadh jaa mahi taa kee ketak aas ||1||
lines.translation: So the one who is filled with the five incurable vices - what hope is there for him? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਧੋ ਅਬਿਦਿਆ ਹਿਤ ਕੀਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: maadho abidiaa hit keen ||
lines.translation: O Lord, he is in love with ignorance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਦੀਪ ਮਲੀਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bibek deep maleen ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: His lamp of clear wisdom has grown dim. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਸੰਭਵ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪ ਅਸੋਚ ॥
lines.transliteration: trigad jon achet sa(n)bhav pu(n)n paap asoch ||
lines.translation: The creeping creatures live thoughtless lives, and cannot discriminate between good and evil.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁਖਾ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਦੁਲਭ ਤਿਹੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੋਚ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: maanukhaa avataar dulabh tihee sa(n)gat poch ||2||
lines.translation: It is so difficult to obtain this human incarnation, and yet, they keep company with the low. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਲਗੁ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਬਸਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t jahaa jahaa lag karam ke bas jaai ||
lines.translation: Wherever the beings and creatures are, they are born according to the karma of their past actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਅਬਧ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਉਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kaal phaas abadh laage kachh na chalai upaai ||3||
lines.translation: The noose of death is unforgiving, and it shall catch them; it cannot be warded off. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ਤਜੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਪਨ ਤਪੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: ravidaas daas udaas taj bhram tapan tap gur giaan ||
lines.translation: O servant Ravi Daas, dispel your sorrow and doubt, and know that Guru-given spiritual wisdom is the penance of penances.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat jan bhai haran paramaana(n)d karahu nidaan ||4||1||
lines.translation: O Lord, Destroyer of the fears of Your humble devotees, make me supremely blissful in the end. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਤੁਝੀ ਤਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t tujhee tan sa(n)gat praan ||
lines.translation: Your Saints are Your body, and their company is Your breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: satigur giaan jaanai sa(n)t devaa dev ||1||
lines.translation: By the True Guru-given spiritual wisdom, I know the Saints as the gods of gods. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਕਥਾ ਰਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t chee sa(n)gat sa(n)t kathaa ras ||
lines.translation: O Lord, God of gods, grant me the Society of the Saints,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਾਝੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t prem maajhai deejai devaa dev ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The sublime essence of the Saints' conversation, and the Love of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਆਚਰਣ ਸੰਤ ਚੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤ ਚ ਓਲ੍ਹਗ ਓਲ੍ਹਗਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t aacharan sa(n)t cho maarag sa(n)t ch olhag olhaganee ||2||
lines.translation: The Character of the Saints, the lifestyle of the Saints, and the service of the servant of the Saints. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਰ ਇਕ ਮਾਗਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aur ik maagau bhagat chi(n)taaman ||
lines.translation: I ask for these, and for one thing more - devotional worship, which shall fulfill my desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਣੀ ਲਖਾਵਹੁ ਅਸੰਤ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਣਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: janee lakhaavahu asa(n)t paapee san ||3||
lines.translation: Do not show me the wicked sinners. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਭਣੈ ਜੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ravidaas bhanai jo jaanai so jaan ||
lines.translation: Says Ravi Daas, he alone is wise, who knows this:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਅਨੰਤਹਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t ana(n)tahi a(n)tar naahee ||4||2||
lines.translation: there is no difference between the Saints and the Infinite Lord. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਚੰਦਨ ਹਮ ਇਰੰਡ ਬਾਪੁਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum cha(n)dan ham ira(n)d baapure sa(n)g tumaare baasaa ||
lines.translation: You are sandalwood, and I am the poor castor oil plant, dwelling close to you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਚ ਰੂਖ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: neech rookh te ooch bhae hai ga(n)dh suga(n)dh nivaasaa ||1||
lines.translation: From a lowly tree, I have become exalted; Your fragrance, Your exquisite fragrance now permeates me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maadhau satasa(n)gat saran tumhaaree ||
lines.translation: O Lord, I seek the Sanctuary of the company of Your Saints;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਉਗਨ ਤੁਮੑ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham augan tumh upakaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am worthless, and You are so benevolent. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਮਖਤੂਲ ਸੁਪੇਦ ਸਪੀਅਲ ਹਮ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਜਸ ਕੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum makhatool suped sapeeal ham bapure jas keeraa ||
lines.translation: You are the white and yellow threads of silk, and I am like a poor worm.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਮਧੁਪ ਮਖੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat mil raheeai maadhau jaise madhup makheeraa ||2||
lines.translation: O Lord, I seek to live in the Company of the Saints, like the bee with its honey. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਤੀ ਓਛਾ ਪਾਤੀ ਓਛਾ ਓਛਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaatee ochhaa paatee ochhaa ochhaa janam hamaaraa ||
lines.translation: My social status is low, my ancestry is low, and my birth is low as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: raajaa raam kee sev na keenee kahi ravidaas chamaaraa ||3||3||
lines.translation: I have not performed the service of the Lord, the Lord, says Ravi Daas the cobbler. ||3||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa bhaio jau tan bhaio chhin chhin ||
lines.translation: What would it matter, if my body were cut into pieces?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਉ ਡਰਪੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: prem jaai tau darapai tero jan ||1||
lines.translation: If I were to lose Your Love, Lord, then Your humble servant would be afraid. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਅਰਬਿੰਦ ਭਵਨ ਮਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tujhahi charan arabi(n)d bhavan man ||
lines.translation: Your lotus feet are the home of my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਨ ਕਰਤ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਾਇਓ ਰਾਮਈਆ ਧਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paan karat paaio paaio raamaeeaa dhan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Drinking in Your Nectar, I have obtained the wealth of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਪਤਿ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਪਟਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)pat bipat patal maaiaa dhan ||
lines.translation: Prosperity, adversity, property and wealth are just Maya.
